resources.coverage_rule: complete simultaneous component cycles inside actual action; first cycle starts within50ms; last boundary and cycle gaps <=1s +50ms scheduling tolerance; probes <=1s; one cycle allowed when action is shorter than schedule; no continuous-peak guarantee

memory_budget.unit_policy: GB=1000000000 bytes; MB=1000000 bytes; display MiB=1048576 bytes
memory_budget.scope: Observed application subtree working set plus PostgreSQL/Redis process RSS. Shared pages may be counted repeatedly; not unique physical memory or EXE acceptance.
